17/// The inner representation of an external graphics state.
18#[derive(Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq, Default, Clone)]
19struct Repr {
20    /// The non-stroking alpha.
21    non_stroking_alpha: Option<NormalizedF32>,
22    /// The stroking alpha.
23    stroking_alpha: Option<NormalizedF32>,
24    /// The blend mode.
25    blend_mode: Option<BlendMode>,
26    /// An active mask.
27    mask: Option<Ref>,
28}
29
30/// A graphics state containing information about
31/// - The current stroking alpha.
32/// - The current non-stroking alpha.
33/// - The current blend mode.
34/// - The current mask.
35///
36/// This struct provides exposes a builder pattern for setting the various properties
37/// individually.
38///
39/// This type is cheap to clone.
40#[derive(Debug, Clone, Hash, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
41pub(crate) struct ExtGState(Arc<Repr>);
42
43impl ExtGState {
44    /// Create a new, empty graphics state.
45    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
46        Self::default()
47    }
48
49    /// Create a new graphics state with a stroking alpha.
50    #[must_use]
51    pub(crate) fn stroking_alpha(mut self, stroking_alpha: NormalizedF32) -> Self {
52        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).stroking_alpha = Some(stroking_alpha);
53        self
54    }
55
56    /// Create a new graphics state with a non-stroking alpha.
57    #[must_use]
58    pub(crate) fn non_stroking_alpha(mut self, non_stroking_alpha: NormalizedF32) -> Self {
59        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).non_stroking_alpha = Some(non_stroking_alpha);
60        self
61    }
62
63    /// Create a new graphics state with a blend mode.
64    #[must_use]
65    pub(crate) fn blend_mode(mut self, blend_mode: BlendMode) -> Self {
66        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).blend_mode = Some(blend_mode);
67        self
68    }
69
70    /// Create a new graphics state with a mask.
71    #[must_use]
72    pub(crate) fn mask(mut self, mask: Mask, sc: &mut SerializeContext) -> Self {
73        let mask_ref = sc.register_cacheable(mask);
74        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).mask = Some(mask_ref);
75        self
76    }
77
78    /// Check whether the graphics state is empty.
79    pub(crate) fn empty(&self) -> bool {
80        self.0.mask.is_none()
81            && self.0.stroking_alpha.is_none()
82            && self.0.non_stroking_alpha.is_none()
83            && self.0.blend_mode.is_none()
84    }
85
86    /// Integrate another graphics state into the current one. This is done by replacing
87    /// all active properties of the other graphics state in the current graphics state, while
88    /// leaving the inactive ones unchanged.
89    pub(crate) fn combine(&mut self, other: &ExtGState) {
90        if let Some(stroking_alpha) = other.0.stroking_alpha {
91            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).stroking_alpha = Some(stroking_alpha);
92        }
93
94        if let Some(non_stroking_alpha) = other.0.non_stroking_alpha {
95            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).non_stroking_alpha = Some(non_stroking_alpha);
96        }
97
98        if let Some(blend_mode) = other.0.blend_mode {
99            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).blend_mode = Some(blend_mode);
100        }
101
102        if let Some(mask) = other.0.mask {
103            Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).mask = Some(mask);
104        }
105    }
106}
107
108impl Cacheable for ExtGState {
109    fn chunk_container(&self) -> ChunkContainerFn {
110        |cc| &mut cc.ext_g_states
111    }
112
113    fn serialize(self, sc: &mut SerializeContext, root_ref: Ref) -> Deferred<Chunk> {
114        let mut chunk = Chunk::new();
115
116        let mut ext_st = chunk.ext_graphics(root_ref);
117        if let Some(nsa) = self.0.non_stroking_alpha {
118            if nsa != NormalizedF32::ONE {
119                sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::Transparency(sc.location));
120            }
121
122            ext_st.non_stroking_alpha(nsa.get());
123        }
124
125        if let Some(sa) = self.0.stroking_alpha {
126            if sa != NormalizedF32::ONE {
127                sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::Transparency(sc.location));
128            }
129
130            ext_st.stroking_alpha(sa.get());
131        }
132
133        if let Some(bm) = self.0.blend_mode {
134            if bm != BlendMode::Normal {
135                sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::Transparency(sc.location));
136            }
137
138            ext_st.blend_mode(bm);
139        }
140
141        if let Some(mask_ref) = self.0.mask {
142            sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::Transparency(sc.location));
143
144            ext_st.pair(Name(b"SMask"), mask_ref);
145        }
146
147        ext_st.finish();
148
149        Deferred::new(|| chunk)
150    }
151}
152
153impl Resourceable for ExtGState {
154    type Resource = resource::ExtGState;
155}

157/// A simulation of the PDF graphics state, so that we
158/// can write our transforms/graphics state all at once
159/// when adding an image/path instead of having to
160/// use `save_state`/`restore_state` excessively.
161#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Clone)]
162pub(crate) struct GraphicsState {
163    ext_g_state: ExtGState,
164    ctm: Transform,
165}
166impl Eq for GraphicsState {}
167
168impl Hash for GraphicsState {
169    fn hash<H: std::hash::Hasher>(&self, state: &mut H) {
170        self.ext_g_state.hash(state);
171        self.ctm.hash(state);
172    }
173}
174
175impl Default for GraphicsState {
176    fn default() -> Self {
177        Self {
178            ext_g_state: ExtGState::new(),
179            ctm: Transform::identity(),
180        }
181    }
182}
183
184impl GraphicsState {
185    pub(crate) fn combine(&mut self, other: &ExtGState) {
186        self.ext_g_state.combine(other);
187    }
188
189    pub(crate) fn concat_transform(&mut self, transform: Transform) {
190        self.ctm = self.ctm.pre_concat(transform);
191    }
192
193    pub(crate) fn transform(&self) -> Transform {
194        self.ctm
195    }
196
197    pub(crate) fn ext_g_state(&self) -> &ExtGState {
198        &self.ext_g_state
199    }
200}
201
202/// A collection of graphics states, simulates the stack-like
203/// structure used.
204#[derive(Debug, Hash, Eq, PartialEq)]
205pub struct GraphicsStates {
206    graphics_states: Vec<GraphicsState>,
207}
208
209impl GraphicsStates {
210    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
211        GraphicsStates {
212            graphics_states: vec![GraphicsState::default()],
213        }
214    }
215
216    pub(crate) fn cur(&self) -> &GraphicsState {
217        self.graphics_states.last().unwrap()
218    }
219
220    pub(crate) fn cur_mut(&mut self) -> &mut GraphicsState {
221        self.graphics_states.last_mut().unwrap()
222    }
223
224    pub(crate) fn save_state(&mut self) {
225        let state = self.cur();
226        self.graphics_states.push(state.clone())
227    }
228
229    pub(crate) fn restore_state(&mut self) {
230        self.graphics_states.pop();
231    }
232
233    pub(crate) fn combine(&mut self, other: &ExtGState) {
234        self.cur_mut().combine(other);
235    }
236
237    pub(crate) fn transform(&mut self, transform: Transform) {
238        self.cur_mut().concat_transform(transform);
239    }
240
241    pub(crate) fn transform_bbox(&self, bbox: Rect) -> Rect {
242        // Important: This does not take the root transform of the
243        // corresponding ContentBuilder into account, because we
244        // want it to be in krilla coordinates, not in PDF
245        // coordinates.
246        bbox.transform(self.cur().transform()).unwrap()
247    }
248}
